th 02/Dated: 05 June, 2025 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioner has moved before this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail from apprehending his arrest instituted under Sections 406/420/467/468/471/120B of the IPC.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in the present case.
It is submitted that there is no allegation that the petitioner had very inception to cheat, the informant has done agreement, thus there is no cheating.
It is further submitted that there is no allegation that the petitioner has created forged documents.
He lastly submits that the allegation made against the petitioner is false and purposely concocted by the informant.
4. Learned A.P.P. opposed the prayer for bail.
5. Having regard to the facts of the case, I am inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks Vishal Raghuvanshi vs The State Of Jharkhand .
